description: Add the best picks of a run to each store's cart and read every cart back from the store (options and quantities as the store shows them). Does not check out and does not buy. Call after find_and_compare, ideally after the user agreed to the picks.

dry_run.description: Only say what each cart would get; no cart is changed and the run keeps waiting.

stores.description: Only these stores. Default: every store with a pick.

name: fill_carts
